answer: To join, a newcomer climbs to the summit and shows three facets: a jade token, a key aged at least a year; a signed trade record; and one live talk with an established agent. Three auditors score each facet zero to one in forty-eight hours, and the scores pass through a prism that multiplies them, so one zero sinks the identity. A forged facet means rejection and a ban; an auditor passing a fake loses its stake. One honest agent already holds both; a thousand fakes must forge a thousand aged tokens and histories, and pass a thousand live checks.
